src/app/sentinel/_components/agent-actio.name: Agent action buttons
src/app/sentinel/_components/agent-actio.description: Shows an agent's status and its Quarantine, Stop and Dismiss buttons, or Release to undo a stop.

src/app/sentinel/_components/agent-detai.name: Selected agent panel
src/app/sentinel/_components/agent-detai.description: Shows everything about the agent a person picked: its job, its risk, what it did wrong and the action buttons.

src/app/sentinel/_components/agent-queue.name: Recommendation list
src/app/sentinel/_components/agent-queue.description: Lists what Sentinel recommends, one row per agent, so a person can pick one or several and act on them.

src/app/sentinel/_components/event-log.t.name: What Sentinel saw
src/app/sentinel/_components/event-log.t.description: Shows the latest timestamped events, such as a planted credential being touched or a recommendation being made.

src/app/sentinel/_components/fleet-headl.name: Headline numbers
src/app/sentinel/_components/fleet-headl.description: Shows one plain sentence about the team and the four animated numbers: agents watched, flagged, peak risk, time to detect.

src/app/sentinel/_components/fleet-scatt.name: Map of agents
src/app/sentinel/_components/fleet-scatt.description: Draws each agent as a dot; normal agents cluster together and a hijacked one turns red and drifts away. Labels stay clickable when dots overlap.

src/app/sentinel/_components/limits-card.name: What Sentinel cannot do
src/app/sentinel/_components/limits-card.description: Lists Sentinel's honest limits, such as needing a clean starting point and only recommending, never acting.

src/app/sentinel/_components/patient-zer.name: Patient-zero card
src/app/sentinel/_components/patient-zer.description: Shows the first agent to reach risk 75, when it started and what it touched. Nothing on the page uses it any more.

src/app/sentinel/_components/recommendat.name: Approve or dismiss card
src/app/sentinel/_components/recommendat.description: Shows Sentinel's group recommendation with Approve and Dismiss buttons. Nothing on the page uses it any more.

src/app/sentinel/_components/related-age.name: Who it talked to
src/app/sentinel/_components/related-age.description: Lists everyone the selected agent messaged in the last 5 minutes and which of them look infected.

src/app/sentinel/_components/results-pan.name: Test results panel
src/app/sentinel/_components/results-pan.description: Shows the validation numbers, or says the test runs have not been done yet.

src/app/sentinel/_components/tier.tsx.name: Risk level look
src/app/sentinel/_components/tier.tsx.description: One place that decides the label, colour and dot for each risk level, plus a clock helper for times.

src/app/sentinel/_components/why-flagged.name: Why it was flagged
src/app/sentinel/_components/why-flagged.description: Draws bars for the behaviours that pushed an agent's score up most, in plain words.
